senses.gloss: मकमकाय maka-makā-ya, onom. Ā. croak 🞄(of frogs).

माकर mākara, a. (ī) relating to the sea-monster 🞄Makara;
 with ākara, m. mine of 🞄Makaras, ocean.

माकरन्द mākaranda, a. derived from or 🞄consisting of the juice of flowers;
 full of honey.

मकरिका makar-ikā, f. kind of head-dress;
 🞄makara-like figure.

मकरी makar-ī, f. female makara: -pattra, 🞄n. mark of a makarī made on the face of 🞄Lakṣmī;
 -lekhā, f. id..
मकुष्ठ makuṣṭha, m. kind of bean (Phaseolus 🞄aconitifolius).

मक्षिका mákṣ-ikā, f. fly;
 bee (sts. a, m. on 🞄account of metre in C.).

माक्षीक mākṣīka, m. spider;
 n. honey: 🞄-dhātu, m. the mineral pyrites.

माकन्द mākanda, m. mango tree: ī, f. N. 🞄of a town on the Ganges;
 i-kā, f. id..

माकिस् mā́-kis, ad. (used only in prohibitive 🞄sentences with the subjunctive) may or let not;
 🞄may no one (RV.).
